speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
question: How does freedom meet difference?
premises: From the complete Whole — oh, joy-taste juice — You lead Your own power into difference, by will's spreading.
Priceless Your freedom — praising Your wonder-become power, fear melted, I am Śiva-made.
inference: Whole leads power into difference; praise melts fear into Śiva-made.
